name: czrecoil_frame_on_menu_open_help_docs
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuOpenHelpDocs checks the help document association, maps FindExecutableA failure codes through the recovered table, reports localized errors, or launches the docs.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x430ad0 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.

The native smoke patches only the smoke process: KERNEL32 FormatMessageA/LocalFree supply zLoc text, while FindExecutableA, ShellExecuteA, and MFC42 CWnd::MessageBoxA are patched through import slots; all patches are restored before return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x430ad0 validates FindExecutableA("Docs\\Index.html"), localized title copy from message id 0x19, error-code remap table at 0x430c04, message ids 0x20/0x22/0x24/0x21, and ShellExecuteA(g_RecoilApp_hWndMain, "open", "Docs\\Index.html", 0, 0, SW_HIDE).
The recovered table is modeled in source as kFindExecutableErrorMap inside CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuOpenHelpDocs; it is data referenced by the function rather than a separately authored owner entry.
The native smoke verifies success, default fallthrough error code 1, and representative remapped error codes 0, 2, 11, and 31.
